parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift`. Although the two test methods `invalidFeatureFlagFallsBackToDefault` (line 108) and `nonStringFeatureFlagFallsBackToDefault` (line 122) share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.778), they are deliberately distinct test cases exercising two separate invalid-input scenarios for the feature-flag fallback path. Collapsing or extracting them would obscure the intent of each scenario and couple test semantics in a way that reduces diagnostic clarity when one case fails but not the other.
